entries.said: FY26 constant currency revenue growth is expected to be between 3% and 3.5%
entries.quote: The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.
entries.speaker: Salil Parekh
entries.delivered: FY26 revenue growth reached 3.1% in constant currency terms, fulfilling the raised 3% to 3.5% guidance band.

entries.said: Operating margin guidance for FY26 is maintained at 20% to 22%
entries.quote: Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.
entries.speaker: Salil Parekh
entries.delivered: Reported Q3 FY26 adjusted operating margin of 21.2% and Q4 FY26 operating margin of 20.9%, meeting the 20%-22% guidance.
entries.evidence: c1 call reported section and c3 call reported section

entries.said: The company expects to complete 20,000 campus hires for the full fiscal year
entries.quote: We will do 20,000 campus hires and we will continue in that sort of a range for next year because these are new areas of demand.
entries.speaker: Salil Parekh
entries.delivered: Infosys successfully completed 20,000 college graduate campus hires for the full fiscal year.

entries.said: Infosys expects FY27 constant currency revenue growth to be between 1.5% and 3.5% year-on-year.
entries.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms.
entries.speaker: Salil Parekh
entries.delivered: Initial FY27 growth guidance of 1.5%-3.5% was cut to 1.5%-3% in Q1 and reduced further to 1%-2% in Q2 FY27.
entries.evidence: c3.g1, c4.g1, and c5.g1 guidance statements

entries.said: Operating margin guidance for financial year 2027 is 20% to 22%.
entries.quote: Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
entries.speaker: Salil Parekh
entries.delivered: Q1 FY27 operating margin was 21.1% and Q2 FY27 was 21.0%, staying within the maintained 20% to 22% band.
entries.evidence: c4 call reported section and c5 call reported section

entries.said: A net new mega deal is expected to contribute over 1% revenue growth for the company in FY28.
entries.quote: This deal is expected to contribute over 1% growth for the company in FY28.
entries.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka
entries.delivered: Net new mega deal projected to add >1% revenue growth in FY28; requires FY28 revenue reporting to evaluate.

summary: Management is highly reliable on margin discipline (20-22% delivered) and fresher hiring targets. However, revenue growth guidance for FY27 was cut twice (from 1.5%-3.5% down to 1%-2%), indicating limited top-line predictability.
business: Infosys delivers digital services and AI solutions. Key reported verticals include Financial Services and Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services. Digital revenue accounts for over 65% of revenue, and AI training reaches 90% of developers.
bull: FY26 constant currency revenue growth hit 3.1%, meeting full-year guidance as total revenue surpassed $20 billion.
Operating margins consistently stayed within the targeted 20% to 22% range from Q3 FY26 through Q2 FY27.
AI revenue share scaled to 10.5% in Q2 FY27, backed by $5.2 billion in large deal TCV.
bear: FY27 constant currency growth guidance was cut twice, dropping from an initial 1.5%-3.5% down to 1%-2%.
Constant currency revenue growth slowed from 4.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to 1.5% YoY in Q2 FY27.
PAT fell 2.3% YoY in Q3 FY26, demonstrating vulnerability to margin squeeze or non-operating items.
